thread:
Marta (CS): quick roundup from the pilot calls — customers keep asking for clearer cost attribution. dropping a compact capture so we can triage.
Ben (CS): paste the short list and i'll flag renewal-risk ones.
Marta (CS): CSV snippet (trimmed):
```
acct,ask,type,impact,notes
trailhead,cost-mapping,feature,high,need per-feature & per-route allocation for internal billing
ember,segmentation-tags,feature,medium,want freeform tags on requests for chargeback
nova,spend-alerts,feature,high,wants webhook/email when project spends > threshold
```
Ivy (PM): cost-mapping sounds like a multipiece ask. are they asking for UI, API, or raw exports?
Marta (CS): Trailhead asked for three things: 1) exportable CSV showing per-feature/per-route breakdown, 2) ability to map routes to internal product codes, 3) a small UI to upload mapping CSV that persists for exports. They mentioned renewal concerns if finance can't reconcile.
Ben (CS): Ember's tags are similar to Meridian from last week — they want tags persisted in usage rows so finance can slice by project. Renewal note: Ember expanding pilot contingent on chargeback visibility.
Leo (Eng): quick tech take: CSV export + mapping overlay is easiest — aggregate job + CSV writer + mapping table. Tags require ingestion header + storage change. Alerts need webhook infra + budget tracking. Rough estimates: export+mapping ~4 dev days, tags spike 3d + 4d work, alerts ~1.5 weeks.
Ivy (PM): propose phased delivery: A) per-route/per-feature CSV export + mapping UI (pilot) B) tags ingestion MVP for Q2 C) webhook spend alerts as a follow-up.
Marta (CS): agree. A gives immediate reconciliation capability for Trailhead and can be marketed as a finance pilot. we'll offer a staging export to them in 7 business days.
feedback-bot: created jira CS-7300 "per-feature cost-export + mapping UI (CS pilot)" assigned to @leo.
Leo (Eng): got it, i'll spin up a spike tomorrow and post a sample CSV schema. initial ACs i'll add to the ticket: 1) CSV includes feature_id, route, date, token_count, request_count, cost_estimate; 2) mapping table supports upload CSV and persists; 3) export respects org scoping and PII flags; 4) signed URL delivery.
Ben (CS): i'll draft two short customer quotes for the ticket: "We can't reconcile costs to product teams without a per-feature ledger." and "If finance can't map spend, we can't sign annual terms."
Ivy (PM): i'll slot export+mapping into next sprint and create a follow-up ticket for tags + alerts. can we commit to staging link in 7 business days?
Leo (Eng): tentative yes for the export+mapping prototype in 7 business days. will confirm after spike.
Marta (CS): i'll reach out to Trailhead and Ember with the proposed plan and offer the staging link once ready. also adding these to the renewal playbook.
Ben (CS): one more ask from a small account — they want a one-click "finance pack" that bundles last 90 days CSV + sample invoices. low effort?
Leo (Eng): we can bundle exports server-side; add an email/signed URL flow. extra 2 dev days. maybe scope as part of the pilot if we have bandwidth.
Ivy (PM): keep it in the backlog as a nice-to-have. pilot focus remains export+mapping + tags spike.
Marta (CS): thanks team. i'll update CS-7300 with the staging customer list and call links. :white_check_mark:
